title: Compiler Dependency Inventory — Karkain 1.0.0 (Stable)
scope: The single source of truth for what the Karkain compiler holds today, what it owns on the path to self-hosting, and which Go/C components are bootstrap infrastructure versus compiler responsibility. Phases 121 (Compiler Independence Foundation) and 122 (Compiler Pipeline Ownership) treat this inventory as their baseline.

lexer.active_path: kcc (self-hosted) is the default engine for check/build/run; its lexer is src/compiler/lexer.kark. Go lexer serves LSP, fmt, the bootstrap stage-1 (KARKAIN_ENGINE=go), and Go-front-end fallbacks.

parser.go: pkg/parser (13 files), entry parser.go, phase120 makes print(value) and print value parity
parser.active_path: kcc parses with src/compiler/parser.kark; bootstrap stage-1 and Go tooling parse with pkg/parser.

ast.active_path: kcc builds src/compiler ASTs; Go builds pkg/parser ASTs.

semantic_analysis.active_path: kcc check/build/run run the self-hosted checker for compiler-internal passes; the Go resolver powers runSemanticPreflight/kccTargetPreflight which gate BOTH engines at the CLI layer (K002/K102 errors, exit 3).

kir.go: NONE (Go only routes: pkg/cli/kir.go KCCKirCommand + KCCKirVerifyCommand)
kir.active_path: kcc kir / karkain kir emit deterministic KIR v1 text via src/compiler/kir.kark. Phase 121 makes KIR an engine-internal invariant: kirVerify runs inside checkFile on the default kcc check path (silent on success, error[K121] + exit 3 on drift) and standalone via kcc verifykir / karkain kir --verify. KIR text does not yet feed the backend (documented post-121 boundary).

assembly.karkain: src/compiler/main.kark assembleProject + helpers (moduleImportNames, stripModuleImports, siblingContent, moduleDirSource, resolveStdlibModule, resolveUserModule, marker-gated findStdlibRoot)
assembly.active_path: Phase 122: kcc composes its OWN input for FLAT projects (no karkain.toml; imports std.* or sibling-resolvable) on the real CLI path — check/build/run/kir/verifykir all stage through kccStageInput (sandbox mirror + lib/ stdlib tree) and assemble in assembleProject. The compiler's own 10-file tree, examples/module_system and examples/stdlib_v2 all assemble this way. Manifest / workspace / package-manager assemblies and transitive non-local resolution keep the Go module-aware kccAssembleSource/resolveSourcesRun (documented BRIDGE).

codegen.go: pkg/codegen (63 files), entry codegen.go (C23 emit + native/DWARF/SIMD/WASM/npu)
codegen.active_path: kcc build/run use src/compiler/codegen.kark; bootstrap stage-1 uses pkg/codegen.

runtime.go: pkg/codegen preamble helpers (C strings), pkg/runtime gate harnesses
runtime.active_path: Generated C links against the embedded runtime helpers emitted by both codegen paths.

bootstrap.contract: stage-1: Go front end emits src/compiler/main.c; gcc links kcc.exe. Bootstrap identity gate asserts stage2 == stage3 bitwise.
bootstrap.active_path: kccBinaryPath rebuilds kcc.exe when any src/compiler/*.kark is newer (kccStale).

pipeline.source: desc('assembly -> lexer -> parser -> AST -> semantic analysis -> KIR -> code generation -> runtime -> executable')
pipeline.kir_invariant: KIR is verified by the compiler itself on the default kcc check path (kirVerify in checkFile, error[K121] on drift). Text remains on-demand (kcc kir / karkain kir); wiring it into build/run as the codegen input is a post-121 boundary.
pipeline.flat_assembly_ownership: since Phase 122 the compiler composes its own input for flat projects (assembleProject in src/compiler/main.kark); Go only stages it into a sandbox (kccStageInput + lib/ mirror). Non-flat (manifest/workspace/PM) assemblies remain Go-owned.

ownership_horizon.current: 10 .kark files under src/compiler run the kcc engine end-to-end (assemble/lex/parse/check/codegen), bootstrapped through the Go front end. Flat-project assembly (sibling + std.* imports) is Karkain-owned as of Phase 122.
ownership_horizon.target: Karkain compiler components invoke themselves: kcc gains Karkain-owned manifest/workspace/PM-aware module resolution and KIR-consumption (Phase 123+).
ownership_horizon.ultimate: KCC self-hosting: the Karkain compiler rebuilds itself with no Go compiler front-end responsibility.

invariants: path-less `source: <basename>` header and `[ok] kir text: N lines` marker
byte-deterministic output for identical input across runs and sandboxes
parse errors surface before emission (exit 3), never a partial `[ok]`
structural_rules: header line exactly `KIR v1`; source line names exactly the basename
two-space indentation per depth level; nesting depth never jumps forward by more than one level
every statement line ends ` line: <decimal>` except `block` and `stmt <type>`
verified by kirVerify inside checkFile on the default kcc check path (error[K121] + exit 3 on drift)
kir_contract.serialization: text v1, one line per statement, depth-indented, all expression forms parenthesized
